d:
Official video for D.C. based singer and songwriter Vidya Vox’s 2015 mashup cover of Justin Bieber's “Sorry” from his album Purpose, and A.R.Rahman's "Kandukondain Kandukondain” from the movie Kandukondain Kandukondain.
I've been loving "Sorry" by Justin Bieber and Skrillex recently. I love the beat, the feeling and lyrics. So I had to mash it up with one of my favorite Tamil songs, KanduKondain Kandukodain by A.R. Rehman. All the songs in that movie are SO good - take a listen if you haven't heard them before. Happy listening!
